The '''Radama Void''' was an area of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] that surrounded the planet of [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]]. Once located at the western edge of [[Xim/Legends|Xim's]] empire, it was separated from the [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Worlds]] by the [[Stygian Caldera]].
